one_line: A trans-Himalayan Ladakhi caravan merchant of the Lopchak missions linking pashmina pastures, Leh, Kashmir, Central Asia and Lhasa.

appearance.age_look: Early 30s, lean from high-altitude travel, wiry but strong build of someone used to long caravan journeys.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, light brown Himalayan complexion tanned by sun, straight nose, slightly wind-chapped lips, faint crow’s feet from squinting in snow glare, default expression a calm, alert gaze that suggests quiet calculation and reliability.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a neat low braid at the back, front hair parted slightly off-centre and smoothed back, all under a dark maroon woollen Ladakhi cap (perak-style base without the tall turquoise crest) that fits snugly to the head and has a narrow, folded edge in muted indigo.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, wrap-style woollen goncha robe in warm chestnut brown, made of thick homespun twill, crossing left over right and belted firmly at the waist with a wide dark indigo wool sash; over this, a sleeveless, slightly padded waistcoat of deep bottle green wool with simple vertical quilting, practical for riding; the goncha’s wide sleeves are rolled back at the wrists to reveal an inner layer of off-white undyed wool; his trousers are loose, ankle-length dark grey wool tucked into sturdy, soft leather boots dyed dark brown with simple stitched bands at the top; around his neck is a modest string of small coral and turquoise beads mixed with brass spacers, and on his right hand he wears a single plain silver ring; a short, dark-red wool scarf is wrapped once around his neck and tucked into the front of his robe, and a sturdy leather belt at the sash holds a small pouch and loop for hanging his tool.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved wooden-handled yak-hide ledger case, worn over one shoulder with a dark tan leather strap, containing folded paper account-books and seals, with one end reinforced in brass and a small brass clasp; he often holds a rolled parchment from it in one hand while the case rests against his hip.

ref_desc: A lean early-30s Ladakhi merchant with tanned oval face, black hair in a low braid under a dark maroon cap, wearing a chestnut brown wool goncha, bottle-green quilted waistcoat, dark indigo sash, dark grey trousers, brown boots, coral-turquoise beads, and carrying a yak-hide ledger case with brass ends.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a trans-Himalayan Ladakhi Lopchak caravan merchant: an early-30s, lean but strong man with an oval face, sun-tanned Himalayan complexion, high cheekbones, and a calm, alert expression, his thick black hair tied into a neat low braid at the back, front hair parted slightly off-centre and smoothed under a snug dark maroon wool Ladakhi cap with a narrow indigo edge; he is fully clothed in a long chestnut brown wool goncha robe wrapping left over right, belted tightly with a wide dark indigo wool sash, with wide sleeves showing rolled-back cuffs and an off-white inner layer, over which he wears a sleeveless deep bottle-green quilted wool waistcoat; his loose dark grey wool trousers tuck into sturdy dark brown leather boots with simple stitched bands, and he has a short dark-red wool scarf wrapped once around his neck; show a modest necklace of small coral and turquoise beads with brass spacers, a plain silver ring on his right hand, and a practical leather belt with a small pouch; his signature prop is a long, slightly curved wooden-handled yak-hide ledger case with a dark tan shoulder strap, brass-reinforced end and clasp, hanging at his hip while he holds a rolled parchment from it; keep the palette to chestnut brown, deep bottle green, dark indigo, dark maroon, off-white and dark brown, and present him from multiple angles to emphasize consistent face, braid, cap, robe, waistcoat, sash, boots and ledger case.
